Ends the session that owns this refresh token. Always succeeds (idempotent).

Changes the password, signs out all other sessions and returns new tokens for this one.

Deletes the account: owned groups go to the oldest admin (or member), or are deleted if
you are alone in them; you leave every group; your profile is anonymized.

ActivityUpdate.title: ActivityUpdate
ActivityUpdate.description: The complete new state. ``owner_id: null`` means unowned.

CardAttribute.title: CardAttribute
CardAttribute.description: A custom-field value shown on the backlog card (its definition has ``show_on_card``).

EventRef.title: EventRef
EventRef.description: A calendar event linked to an activity (``Activity.events``, by ``window_start``).

EventUpdate.title: EventUpdate
EventUpdate.description: The complete new state of the whole series.

EventWrite.title: EventWrite
EventWrite.description:
A series. Rules (contract section 5.8):

- ``one_time``: no ``rrule``. ``recurring``: an ``rrule`` from the allowed subset (stored
  canonical). ``birthday``: all-day, ``end_date`` null or equal to ``start_date``, ``rrule``
  null or ``FREQ=YEARLY`` (29 February is allowed).
- All-day: ``start_date`` (``end_date`` null means the same day) and no instants. Timed:
  ``starts_at`` < ``ends_at`` and no dates. At most 30 days long.
- ``timezone`` null means the group's.

FieldDef.title: FieldDef
FieldDef.description:
A custom field of a category (contract section 6.1). The list order is the display order.

Shape rules are checked here, so errors point at e.g. ``field_defs.2.options``. Rules that
need other categories (key conflicts, type changes) are checked by the service.

MyAvailabilityUpdate.title: MyAvailabilityUpdate
MyAvailabilityUpdate.description:
Replaces every entry of mine with ``from_date <= date < to_date`` by ``entries``; a slot
left out becomes unknown.

Occurrence.title: Occurrence
Occurrence.description: One calendar entry: an occurrence of an event, or a member's birthday.

OccurrenceRef.title: OccurrenceRef
OccurrenceRef.description: The next occurrence of an activity's linked events (``ActivitySummary.next_occurrence``).

PollUpdate.title: PollUpdate
PollUpdate.description: The complete new state (``allow_multiple`` can't change).

RecapCategory.title: RecapCategory
RecapCategory.description:
A top-level category and how many memories fall under it (its subcategories
included).

SlotCounts.title: SlotCounts
SlotCounts.description: How the group's current members answered for one slot of a day.

WheelCandidate.title: WheelCandidate
WheelCandidate.description: A slice of the wheel, as it was at spin time.

status.title: Status
status.description: 1..5 statuses. Omitted or null: idea and planning.

WheelFilters.title: WheelFilters
WheelFilters.description:
Which activities go on the wheel; the same semantics as ``list_activities``. There is no
server default for ``interested_by``: the client's "Only ideas I'm interested in" toggle
starts on and sends it.
